answer.original_source: Wendell Weeks, Chairman, CEO and President of Corning, quoted by Fox News Digital on 2026-07-01
answer.new_information: Corning's CEO says the company is in its fastest growth period, will probably double its size over the coming years, and that almost all new hires will be in advanced manufacturing with a significant part in the United States. This supports a company-level outlook for Corning headcount and US manufacturing. Material unknowns: the period is only 'the coming years' with no year-end, the size measure (revenue, capacity, or headcount) is not defined, and no link to NVDA revenue or NVIDIA-specific volumes is stated. Evidence needed to resolve: Corning's own filings or guidance that define the doubling metric and timeframe, and NVIDIA or Corning disclosures on the three-facility optical project's timing and output.
answer.reason: No stored questions, pieces or catalog entries exist for this research scope, so there is no argument to update. The record is a Corning-level growth and hiring outlook with an undefined period and metric, and it does not state any NVDA revenue, volume or contract figure, so it does not support a new NVDA investment question on its own. The NVIDIA-Corning facility details appear only in separate Fox News items and are not part of this record. The record is kept as background context.
